scope: Recovered method-local questions, not claimed new executions or universal impossibilities

entries.question: Accumulated semantic diversity
entries.source_boundary: CPC5/CPC7 preserve opaque directional correspondences; NSM acquisition is not implied by those slots.
entries.decisive_test: Function before name -> physical pairing -> reserved varied referents/context -> retention/use; fixed codec/decoder across opposite histories.

entries.question: Experience-selected relevance
entries.source_boundary: Fixed guards, declared M1/M2 protocols and learned directional pulse are distinct; no general consequence-selected attention was established.
entries.decisive_test: Histories change useful current while evaluation signals/readout remain matched; show physical consequence path and new use without host policy correction.

entries.question: Renewable access during new acquisition
entries.source_boundary: ING01 L2 replenishment and L3 finite adaptation were separate; ING02 stores relative memory but traffic can corrupt reader access.
entries.decisive_test: Track support, readout, receipts, phases, residuals and function separately; old relation must be used after new acquisition without re-teaching.

entries.question: Learned questions and interlocutors
entries.source_boundary: CPC7 has a state-conditioned question on prepared routes; T117 remote request was scheduled, not native initiative.
entries.decisive_test: Keep fixed opportunities but vary experience and usefulness; freeze worlds where different sources are needed; no auditor routing by knowledge table.

entries.question: Role-preserving semantic composition
entries.source_boundary: CPC7 product preserves X/Y/Z locally, while the sign readout loses branchX; arbitrary syntax and new referents remain untested.
entries.decisive_test: Teach components separately, reserve a functional combination/role swap, inspect native result rather than concatenate renderer labels.

entries.question: Communication among full compounds
entries.source_boundary: CPC7 1/2/4 specialists multiply resources and do not establish cooperation of complete integrated compounds.
entries.decisive_test: Same-Runtime source->carrier->receiver->consequence with receptor-history and same-resource route/message controls.

entries.question: Finite learned redundancy versus repair autonomy
entries.source_boundary: CORE17 later closure already demonstrates carrier-supported repair from a trained redundant copy; local self-regeneration without source remains open.
entries.decisive_test: Preserve source/cost/mode; test copied history, wrong direction, source absent and route cut separately from fresh autonomous learning.

entries.question: Hidden knowledge versus physical convergence
entries.source_boundary: A scalar or unavailable reader can hide a distinction; complete-state convergence can really destroy its recoverability.
entries.decisive_test: Same common probe in forks; equalize/ablate candidate support; retain complete-state identity and context coverage.

entries.question: New retained history from a new native contingency
entries.source_boundary: ING06 converged on history->post-host dynamics->reorganized existing opportunities; missing edge is new unpreloaded contingency->new retained history.
entries.decisive_test: Require a new physical consequence and later function, not only evolving RAW or new diagnostic reachability.

entries.question: Later thermal/Rosetta source recovery
entries.source_boundary: PROC03 source is an uninformative discovery cut with holdout untouched; a visible conversation claims later gate tests.
entries.decisive_test: Recover later primary artifact/lock/data before promotion; conversation alone cannot override archived primary results.

entries.question: Post-revision retention of named use
entries.source_boundary: CPC7 sign measured142 was not re-queried after L03 revision402;14-bank retention and named-response retention are different questions.
entries.decisive_test: Query the acquired sign later on the same live MAIN and record admittance, output and query backaction; diagnose separately if port occupied.

entries.question: Causal gate source versus expected return
entries.source_boundary: MBP4 tested exterior products were not shown necessary for the131->132 write; local presence/clock/comparator mattered.
entries.decisive_test: Use late formed-product cuts and exact local-context controls; do not identify a missing T0 input with a late consequence cut.
